canonical_project: Vantage New Albany campus / Vantage OH1
aliases: Vantage New Albany campus / Vantage OH1

history.reason: City construction-status evidence and current project register list Vantage Buildings 1-3 as data-center/data-building projects under Turner Construction.
Vantage official OH1 campus page and June 2025 financing announcement identify 192 MW total IT capacity.

actions.exact_result_status: Council minutes identify Vantage Data Centers OH11 LLC and describe an agreement providing a 100% real-property-tax exemption for the proposed project. The same indexed minutes describe up to three new data-center buildings.
actions.access_caveat: Official PDF is accessible, but web extraction did not expose full roll-call/vote lines in this run.

actions.exact_result_status: Vantage announced $2.25 billion in debt financing to fully fund construction of its New Albany, Ohio campus: three pre-leased hyperscale data centers, 192 MW across 1.5 million square feet on 70 acres, with the first facility slated to be operational by December 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Company-projected operational timing is not treated as verified occupancy, energization, or live status.

actions.body: City of New Albany Community Development
actions.exact_result_status: December 2025 report lists Vantage Building 1 at 3325 Horizon Court, 200,107 square feet, start date October 2024; Vantage Building 2 at 3265 Horizon Court, 500,107 square feet, start date January 2025; and Vantage Building 3 at 3205 Horizon Court, 500,107 square feet, start date March 2025.
actions.access_caveat: Construction-status report supports active construction/site-work status, but does not publish permit numbers, occupancy, energization, or capacity by building.

actions.body: City of New Albany Community Development
actions.exact_result_status: City's current project-updates page lists Vantage Buildings 1, 2, and 3 as new data-center/new-data-building projects, including locations, square footage, contractor Turner Construction, and project descriptions.
actions.access_caveat: Snapshot date is the research access date, not a claimed permit-issue date; page does not publish occupancy or energization.

capacity_note: Vantage describes OH1 as three 64 MW hyperscale data centers totaling 192 MW; city construction reports list building square footage but do not publish MW by building.

contradictions.description: New Albany current project-updates page lists Vantage Building 1 as generally located at Jug & Horizon and 500,107 square feet; New Albany December 2025 construction-status report lists Vantage Building 1 at 3325 Horizon Court and 200,107 square feet.
contradictions.resolution: Use dated December 2025 monthly report for building-level data; retain current-page value in action/NOTES as a conflict.
